title: Finite free comparison of the actual quotient Roos complexes before localization
statement: Let R → S be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings on a site essentially small in the module universe, and E its ordinary scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Suppose S is finite free as an R-module, including rank zero. Let t, v and u be global sections with u locally a unit and φ(t)=u v^e for an integer e≥1. Assume countable products of S-module sheaves are exact. Then E is exact. For every cochain complex P the canonical balanced quotient maps give a strict tower isomorphism E(P ⊗ R/t^(n+1)) ≅ (EP ⊗ S/v^(e(n+1)))_n. Its canonical product comparison induces an isomorphism δ between the actual signed Roos cones, with the two specified product coordinates, and arithmetic restriction gives a quasi-isomorphism a with block/selection coordinates. The two cone maps are natural for all cochain maps, and the balanced tower comparison sends the scalar extension of each quotient map to the corresponding target quotient map. All data are packaged in QuotientRoosExchange; no derived completion functor occurs.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YT and 0941; the indicated explicit steps of lem-pur-finite-free-completion-exchange.

proof.text: Tensor cancellation identifies restricted ordinary extension naturally with tensor by the restricted coefficient algebra. Reuse the proved finite tensor-power isomorphism and conservative scalar-restriction properties from the strict-tower transport module: a finite coproduct of units gives a finite product of identity functors, including the empty basis. The ordinary coefficient adjunction gives colimit preservation; conservative exact restriction detects finite limits and countable product preservation.

Prove the regular-tensor unitor and single-tensor quotient component formulas privately from the monoidal sheafification identities and the single-complex tensor component formula; no completed-integral implementation is imported. Identify each component of the recorded tensor quotient augmentation with the cokernel of the corresponding scalar power, using tensor preservation of cokernels and the typed single-complex tensor isomorphism. Adjunction naturality carries the source scalar power to the product of the unit power and target scalar power. The unit factor is invertible on every section. Cokernel uniqueness gives the degreewise balanced isomorphisms. Cancel the quotient epimorphisms to prove compatibility with differentials, tower transitions and maps of the input complex.

Transpose the balanced tower isomorphism. Compose the canonical public additive comparison on the actual Roos model with the image of that tower isomorphism under roosF. Its product and biproduct projections give the required formulas and strict naturality. Assemble these data in a private categorical tower-comparison lemma before specializing to sheaf modules. Specialize cofinal Roos restriction to the arithmetic embedding n maps to e(n+1)-1. Its block sum is precisely the recorded arithmetic block and its selection map is the recorded selection, giving the quasi-isomorphism and strict naturality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YT and 0941, balanced quotient and actual Roos cone proof; finite-power and cokernel-universality implementation by H8. D3 repairs the rejected H8 import by proving the two elementary tensor identities locally.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFreeQuotientRoosComparison
    (F : SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel.{u, v, r, wR, wS} φ)
    (hfree : ∃ d : ℕ, Nonempty
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S)) ≅
        ∐ (fun _ : Fin d ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
          (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R))))
    (t : (SheafOfModules.unit
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)).sections)
    (vS : (SheafOfModules.unit
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S)).sections)
    (uS : (SheafOfModules.unit
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S)).sections)
    (hu : ∀ U : Cᵒᵖ, IsUnit (@id (S.obj.obj U) (uS.val U)))
    (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (hrelation : ∀ U : Cᵒᵖ,
      φ.hom.app U (@id (R.obj.obj U) (t.val U)) =
        (@id (S.obj.obj U) (uS.val U)) * (@id (S.obj.obj U) (vS.val U)) ^ e)
    [HasExactLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ)
      (ringedSiteModules.{r} (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S))] :
    Nonempty (QuotientRoosExchange F t vS e)
